verses.1: May they be destroyed, for they have sinned against their God. Their cities will be destroyed, and their mountains will be cut down.
verses.2: Let Israel return to the LORD your God, for you have sinned in your rebellion.
verses.3: Take with you some provisions, and return to Jehovah. Say to Him all your troubles. Choose what is good, and let us be satisfied with it. Our words are enough.
verses.4: Ashur will not save us. We cannot ride on his horses, nor can we do what our God has commanded us to do. It is because of you that He shows His mercy.
verses.5: May their return bring love and joy, for my heart has returned from where it was taken.
verses.6: It shall be like rain for Israel; it will bloom like a beautiful flower. Its roots will be like those of a rabbit.
verses.7: Let his daughters go; let there be a place of praise and fragrance, like that of a puppy.
verses.8: May those who sit in the shadow live long, and may they bloom like vines. May their flowers remind us of fine wine.
verses.9: Ephraim, what more can I say? I have answered your questions. I will protect you from harm. Your fruit will be found among us.
verses.10: Who is wise enough to understand these things? Only those who are honest and righteous will follow in their footsteps. The wicked, however, will fail in their efforts.
